name: Niikappu (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Niikappu town emblem in orange: four stylised horse heads arranged around a centre.
history: Municipal flag of Niikappu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 21 March 1968.

features.role: Niikappu town emblem — four stylised horse heads arranged around a centre
